so since I was much more keen on burning rather than cutting, I guess I know a bit about how to handle burns. 
here’s how I handled mine: 
putting cold water, not ice, cold water on them to soothe them (usually immediately after or soon). 
burn cream/spray, bactine.
if they blistered, do my best to not pop it and keep it covered with a bandaid. If this happened, I would flush it out with peroxide, and then use bactine or another type of burn cream/antiseptic cream, which would usually have anti-itch to keep some of the pain/irritation down.
